name: redmine-playwright-tests
description: UI test automation framework for https://www.redmine.org using Playwright with TypeScript, Page Object Model, Allure Report and GitHub Actions.

scripts.allure:clean: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); for (const dir of ['allure-results', 'allure-report']) fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
